BrochureContent.Content: P. Marry & Associates presents to the market this  well-proportioned four bedroom detached house located in the very sought after Townparks area. Within a short walk of the railway station, secondary school and St. Patricks primary school and within easy walking distance of all town centre amenities, this very spacious property is guaranteed to attract and impress a host of interested buyers looking for their ideal home. Boasting many special features, viewing is highly recommended.
